items.title: DevFest Asaba 2026
items.text:
Date: 5 December 2026, 08:00 UTC
Ends: 5 December 2026, 14:00 UTC
Location: Café One Asaba, 180 Nnebisi Road
Registration: Free registration

DevFest 2026 Asaba is coming together to celebrate technology, innovation, and the people building the future.

DevFest is an annual, community-led technology festival organized by Google Developer Groups (GDG) communities around the world. It brings developers, students, tech enthusiasts, entrepreneurs, and industry professionals together to learn about emerging technologies, share knowledge, build connections, and strengthen local tech communities.

DevFest 2026 Asaba is part of this global celebration, bringing the DevFest experience to the Asaba tech ecosystem. The event will provide an opportunity for participants to learn from experienced speakers and industry professionals, discover new technologies and opportunities, connect with like-minded people, and engage in conversations that inspire innovation and growth.

Whether you are a developer, designer, student, founder, tech professional, or simply curious about technology, DevFest Asaba is a place to learn something new, meet people who share your interests, and discover opportunities to take your next step.

Expect insightful talks, practical learning, community conversations, networking, and opportunities to connect with the wider technology ecosystem.

Come ready to learn, connect, build, and grow.
